msg: Hello and good luck with your upcoming task.To be succesful you need to pick the gnome that will lead you to the correct forest. i.e. the forest that will provide the most mushrooms per go.There will be a changing pattern of which forest is the best throughout the game.The best forest will either be a light forest or a dark forest. The gnome colors that take you to either forest will stay the same and are as below:The orange, green, red and blue gnomes will take you to the bright forest.The other gnome color will be paired with one of the above colors and will take you to the dark forest. These will be Brown, pink, yellow and purple.God speed.
